It only *rejects*: NUL byte → `Err` (`:19-24`), `text.len()` (bytes) > 1 MB → `Err` (`:27-32`), `from_utf8` → `Err` (`:35-40`). | **Yes for corruption purposes** — it is a pure gate, never a filter. It can *fail an entire insertion*, but it can never mangle a value. |

This site does **not** deploy to Cloudflare Pages' static-asset pipeline. It deploys a **Cloudflare Worker with a static-assets binding**, so "Pages serves a single root `404.html` for any unmatched request" is not the mechanism in play. The load-bearing claim in the hypothesis is therefore falsified from the repo, and the *conclusion* (Indonesian 404 is dead content) collapses with it, resting entirely on external evidence.
